definitions.explanation: A literary word meaning to wind or meander. Almost exclusively encountered as part of the four-character compound {紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ} (twists and turns, complications). Rarely used on its own in modern Japanese.

examples.japanese: {紆余|うよ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk along a winding road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紆余|うよ}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The river winds its way toward the sea.

examples.japanese: {紆余|うよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、ようやく⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: After many twists and turns, we finally reached a conclusion.

notes:
A highly literary word that is almost always encountered as part of the four-character compound ⟦{紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}→紆余曲折：07289_uyokyokusetsu⟧ (twists and turns, complications). On its own, {紆余|うよ} means to wind or meander, both literally (of roads and rivers) and figuratively (of processes and events).

The characters break down as {紆|う} (to wind, to coil) + {余|よ} (to extend, to spread). Both characters suggest gradual, winding extension.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}→紆余曲折：07289_uyokyokusetsu⟧: twists and turns, complications — by far the most common form
- {紆余|うよ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: a winding road (literary)
- {紆余|うよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧: after going through twists and turns

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紆余曲折|うよきょくせつ}→紆余曲折：07289_uyokyokusetsu⟧: twists and turns — the standard four-character compound
- ⟦{曲折|きょくせつ}→曲折：16399_kyokusetsu⟧: bending, complications — can be used independently unlike {紆余|うよ}
- ⟦{蛇行|だこう}→蛇行：09036_dakou⟧: meandering, winding — specifically for rivers or roads snaking back and forth
